text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. TMG Builders has undertaken the construction of a 40-storey residential building with two levels of underground parking. The site is located on the north side of Maitland Street, between Yonge Street and Church Street. At its meeting of January 24, 2024, Toronto and East York Community Council authorized the temporary closure of the westbound lane on Maitland Street and a portion of the sidewalk on the north side of Maitland Street, from January 25, 2024 to January 31, 2025. At the time, the developer indicated they would require the staging area for a total of 36 months, from January 25, 2024 to December 31, 2026, however, the occupation was only approved for a 12 month period.
